meta.title: Berlin Early Hours Board
meta.travelNote: Door-to-door minutes from the Weltzeituhr at Alexanderplatz, public transport, weekday 07:00.
meta.accessFilterNote: Ticketed places use the explicit access=ticketed field. Indoor alone does not imply a ticket; transport, free registration and fenced free places remain separate.

rows.name: First U-Bahn from Alexanderplatz
rows.note: U2, U5 and U8 start again around 04:05 on weekday mornings. On Saturday and Sunday mornings they never stopped.

rows.name: Weltzeituhr, Alexanderplatz
rows.note: No gate, no ticket. The square is lit all night and the S-Bahn viaduct above it starts moving first.

rows.name: Brandenburg Gate and Tiergarten
rows.note: The one hour of the day when you can stand under the Quadriga without a crowd in the frame.

rows.name: Holocaust Memorial, field of stelae
rows.note: The field of stelae is accessible around the clock. The Information Centre below it opens at 10:00 and is shut on Mondays.

rows.name: Volkspark Humboldthain flak tower
rows.note: A public park with no gate, and a climb onto a wartime flak tower that looks straight back at the TV Tower.

rows.name: East Side Gallery
rows.note: An open-air stretch of the Wall on a public pavement. Early is the only time the paintings are not behind other people's phones.

rows.name: Tempelhofer Feld
rows.note: The old airport runways. Gate times change month by month, so the same walk starts at 06:00 in August and 07:30 in December.

rows.name: Sommerbad Humboldthain

open.seasonLabel: Summer pool. The 2026 season ends on 11 September.

rows.note: An outdoor 50 metre pool that opens at 07:00 six days a week. Everyone aged 14 and over needs an original photo ID at the gate.

rows.name: Reichstag visitor service point
rows.note: The walk-up registration hut near the Reichstag opens at 08:00. The dome itself needs a slot booked in advance.

rows.name: Berliner Dom
rows.note: Opens at 09:00 from Monday to Saturday. On Sunday the building belongs to services until 12:00.

rows.name: TV Tower viewing deck
rows.note: First lift at 09:00. The 09:00 to 10:00 slots are the quietest hour the deck gets all day.

rows.name: DDR Museum
rows.note: 09:00 every day of the week, public holidays included. It is the earliest proper museum in central Berlin and it opens on Mondays.

rows.name: Zoo Berlin
rows.note: Gates at 09:00. Closing moves with the season, so check the day before if you want a long visit.

rows.name: Museum Island museums
rows.note: Altes Museum, Neues Museum, Alte Nationalgalerie and the James-Simon-Galerie all open at 10:00 and all close on Mondays.
